name: CollBoxFace
meaning: return bits of Collide_SweepBoxVsBox (contact normal chosen by priority 0x20,0x10,1,2,8,4)

name: CBF_HIT_MINX
meaning: moving +x into target min-x face; normal (-0x1000,0,0)

name: CBF_HIT_MINY
meaning: moving +y (down) onto the top face; normal (0,-0x1000,0)

name: CBF_HIT_MAXY
meaning: moving up into the underside; normal (0,+0x1000,0)

name: CBF_ALREADY_INSIDE
meaning: overlapping at start: frac 0, no contact normal written (record left with stale normal)
